# runner's --budgets). One row per journey: the most presses and logic
# ticks (30 Hz; a press is 2 ticks) the journey may take from its
# journey-begin to its journey-end. journey-end fails over either, and
# run_journeys.sh fails when a row has no journey or a journey no row.
# "-" = reserved for a later package (no journey yet).

# rows and lowers them when it makes a journey shorter. Today's baselines
# (M0, 2026-11-01); the targets in the notes are the owning package's.
